<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sys_script"><sys_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><abort_action>false</abort_action><access>package_private</access><action_delete>true</action_delete><action_insert>true</action_insert><action_query>false</action_query><action_update>true</action_update><active>true</active><add_message>false</add_message><advanced>true</advanced><change_fields>false</change_fields><client_callable>false</client_callable><collection>sn_quote_mgmt_core_quote</collection><condition/><description/><execute_function>false</execute_function><filter_condition/><is_rest>false</is_rest><message/><name>Auto-create Sales Process Record on Oppo</name><order>100</order><priority>100</priority><rest_method/><rest_method_text/><rest_service/><rest_service_text/><rest_variables/><role_conditions/><script><![CDATA[(function executeRule(current, previous /*null when async*/) {

    // gs.hasRole() treats admin as satisfying every role check, so it can't
    // distinguish an actual partner-portal user from an admin doing the same
    // operation. Check the literal role grant instead.
    var hasExternalRole = false;
    var roleGr = new GlideRecord('sys_user_has_role');
    roleGr.addQuery('user', gs.getUserID());
    roleGr.addQuery('role.name', 'snc_external');
    roleGr.query();
    if (roleGr.next()) {
        hasExternalRole = true;
    }
    if (hasExternalRole) return; // skip Sales Process Record creation for partner portal users

    var util = new BOProcessChainUtil();

    if (current.operation() == 'delete') {
        util.deactivateLinkCascade(current.getUniqueValue());
    } else {
        util.ensureQuoteLink(current.getUniqueValue());
    }

})(current, previous);]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-02 00:47:02</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>9c7d60463b07cf10d5260fa693e45ab0</sys_id><sys_mod_count>12</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Auto-create Sales Process Record on Oppo</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Global" source="global">global</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Global">global</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_9c7d60463b07cf10d5260fa693e45ab0</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-03 05:56:47</sys_updated_on><template/><when>after</when></sys_script><sys_translated_text action="delete_multiple" query="documentkey=9c7d60463b07cf10d5260fa693e45ab0"/></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sys_script"><sys_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><abort_action>false</abort_action><access>package_private</access><action_delete>true</action_delete><action_insert>true</action_insert><action_query>false</action_query><action_update>true</action_update><active>true</active><add_message>false</add_message><advanced>true</advanced><change_fields>false</change_fields><client_callable>false</client_callable><collection>sn_ind_tmt_orm_order_line_item</collection><condition/><description/><execute_function>false</execute_function><filter_condition/><is_rest>false</is_rest><message/><name>Sync Process Record on Order Line Change</name><order>100</order><priority>100</priority><rest_method/><rest_method_text/><rest_service/><rest_service_text/><rest_variables/><role_conditions/><script><![CDATA[(function executeRule(current, previous /*null when async*/) {

    var util = new BOProcessChainUtil();

    if (current.operation() == 'delete') {
        util.deactivateLinkCascade(current.getUniqueValue());
    } else if (!gs.nil(current.order)) {
        util.ensureOrderLink(current.getValue('order'));
    }

})(current, previous);]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-02 01:35:04</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>bb68f8422bcb8f104deaf02ac891bfd6</sys_id><sys_mod_count>1</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Sync Process Record on Order Line Change</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Global" source="global">global</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Global">global</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_bb68f8422bcb8f104deaf02ac891bfd6</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-02 01:35:27</sys_updated_on><template/><when>after</when></sys_script><sys_translated_text action="delete_multiple" query="documentkey=bb68f8422bcb8f104deaf02ac891bfd6"/></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>package_private</access><active>true</active><api_name>global.BOProcessChainUtil</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description/><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>BOProcessChainUtil</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[var BOProcessChainUtil = Class.create();
BOProcessChainUtil.prototype = {
    initialize: function() {},

    TYPES: {
        OPPORTUNITY: 'bbdf87f3ff01221066aeffffffffffd2',
        QUOTE: '06909b37ff01221066aeffffffffff0d',
        ORDER: 'b9c09f37ff01221066aeffffffffff20',
        QUOTE_LINE: 'fea0db37ff01221066aeffffffffff40',
        ORDER_LINE: '9701d377ff01221066aeffffffffff21',
        ORDER_CASE: '3495a0ce2bc78f104deaf02ac891bf7f',
        ORDER_CASE_LINE: '4ba564ce2bc78f104deaf02ac891bfe9'
    },

    TABLES: {
        SPR: 'sn_l2c_cockpit_sales_process_record',
        OPPORTUNITY: 'sn_opty_mgmt_core_opportunity',
        QUOTE: 'sn_quote_mgmt_core_quote',
        QUOTE_LINE: 'sn_quote_mgmt_core_quote_line_item',
        ORDER: 'sn_ind_tmt_orm_order',
        ORDER_LINE: 'sn_ind_tmt_orm_order_line_item',
        ORDER_CASE: 'sn_order_case',
        ORDER_CASE_LINE: 'sn_order_case_line',
        RESOURCE: 'sn_bo_core_process_resource'
    },

    OBJECT_GROUP: '3f1c98c22b878f104deaf02ac891bfec',

    _linkExists: function(businessProcessRecordId, objectSysId, parentTableName, parentObjectSysId) {
        var gr = new GlideRecord(this.TABLES.RESOURCE);
        gr.addQuery('business_process_record', businessProcessRecordId);
        gr.addQuery('object', objectSysId);
        gr.addQuery('parent_table_name', parentTableName);
        gr.addQuery('parent_object', parentObjectSysId);
        gr.addQuery('active', true);
        gr.query();
        return gr.next();
    },

    _createLink: function(businessProcessRecordId, objectTypeId, objectSysId, parentTableName, parentObjectSysId) {
        var gr = new GlideRecord(this.TABLES.RESOURCE);
        gr.initialize();
        gr.setValue('business_process_record', businessProcessRecordId);
        gr.setValue('business_object_type', objectTypeId);
        gr.setValue('object', objectSysId);
        gr.setValue('active', true);
        gr.setValue('parent_table_name', parentTableName);
        gr.setValue('parent_object', parentObjectSysId);
        return gr.insert();
    },

    /**
     * Finds the process record (if any) that already tracks this object,
     * regardless of what it's currently parented under. Used to reuse an
     * existing process record when an object's place in the chain changes
     * (e.g. an opportunity gets added to a quote that was already tracked).
     */
    _findSalesProcessRecordForLinkedObject: function(objectSysId, businessObjectTypeId) {
        var gr = new GlideRecord(this.TABLES.RESOURCE);
        gr.addQuery('object', objectSysId);
        gr.addQuery('business_object_type', businessObjectTypeId);
        gr.addQuery('active', true);
        gr.query();
        if (gr.next()) {
            return gr.getValue('business_process_record');
        }
        return null;
    },

    /**
     * Creates a link for this object if none exists. If it's already linked
     * somewhere else (process record/type/parent changed), retires the old
     * link and inserts a fresh one rather than updating in place - the OOB
     * "Check table name and BOT fields" validation on this table only
     * re-checks business_object_type when that field or business_process_record
     * itself changes, so an update that only moves the parent can be wrongly
     * aborted even though the type was already valid. A plain insert avoids
     * that entirely. Safe to call every time - a no-op if nothing changed.
     */
    _ensureLink: function(businessProcessRecordId, objectTypeId, objectSysId, parentTableName, parentObjectSysId) {
        var gr = new GlideRecord(this.TABLES.RESOURCE);
        gr.addQuery('object', objectSysId);
        gr.addQuery('active', true);
        gr.query();
        if (gr.next()) {
            if (gr.getValue('business_process_record') == businessProcessRecordId &&
                gr.getValue('business_object_type') == objectTypeId &&
                gr.getValue('parent_table_name') == parentTableName &&
                gr.getValue('parent_object') == parentObjectSysId) {
                return gr.getUniqueValue();
            }
            gr.setValue('active', false);
            gr.update();
        }
        return this._createLink(businessProcessRecordId, objectTypeId, objectSysId, parentTableName, parentObjectSysId);
    },

    /**
     * Ensures a Sales Process Record exists for this opportunity and that the
     * opportunity is linked directly under it. Reuses an existing one if found.
     */
    ensureOpportunityLink: function(opportunitySysId) {
        if (!opportunitySysId) {
            return null;
        }

        var salesProcessRecordId = this._findSalesProcessRecordForLinkedObject(opportunitySysId, this.TYPES.OPPORTUNITY);
        if (salesProcessRecordId) {
            return salesProcessRecordId;
        }

        var oppGR = new GlideRecord(this.TABLES.OPPORTUNITY);
        if (!oppGR.get(opportunitySysId)) {
            return null;
        }

        var sprGR = new GlideRecord(this.TABLES.SPR);
        sprGR.initialize();
        sprGR.setValue('account', oppGR.getValue('account'));
        sprGR.setValue('business_object_group', this.OBJECT_GROUP);
        sprGR.setValue('short_description', 'Opportunity to Order process - ' + oppGR.getDisplayValue('short_description'));
        salesProcessRecordId = sprGR.insert();

        if (!salesProcessRecordId) {
            return null;
        }

        this._ensureLink(salesProcessRecordId, this.TYPES.OPPORTUNITY, opportunitySysId, this.TABLES.SPR, salesProcessRecordId);
        return salesProcessRecordId;
    },

    /**
     * Keeps an already-linked Sales Process Record's header fields (currently: account)
     * in sync with its Opportunity. Does not create a new process record - creation is
     * quote-driven, this only refreshes an existing one.
     */
    syncOpportunity: function(opportunitySysId) {
        if (!opportunitySysId) {
            return;
        }

        var salesProcessRecordId = this._findSalesProcessRecordForLinkedObject(opportunitySysId, this.TYPES.OPPORTUNITY);
        if (!salesProcessRecordId) {
            return;
        }

        var oppGR = new GlideRecord(this.TABLES.OPPORTUNITY);
        if (!oppGR.get(opportunitySysId)) {
            return;
        }

        var sprGR = new GlideRecord(this.TABLES.SPR);
        if (sprGR.get(salesProcessRecordId) && sprGR.getValue('account') != oppGR.getValue('account')) {
            sprGR.setValue('account', oppGR.getValue('account'));
            sprGR.update();
        }
    },

    _createProcessRecordForQuote: function(quoteGR) {
        var sprGR = new GlideRecord(this.TABLES.SPR);
        sprGR.initialize();
        sprGR.setValue('account', quoteGR.getValue('account'));
        sprGR.setValue('business_object_group', this.OBJECT_GROUP);
        sprGR.setValue('short_description', 'Quote to Order process - ' + quoteGR.getDisplayValue('number'));
        return sprGR.insert();
    },

    /**
     * Ensures the chain Process Record -> [Opportunity ->] Quote exists for this
     * quote, and syncs the quote's current line items underneath it. If the quote
     * has no source_opportunity, the Quote links directly under the Process Record
     * instead (skipping the Opportunity level). If an opportunity is added later,
     * the existing process record is reused and the quote is re-parented under the
     * opportunity in place - no duplicate process record is created. Safe to call
     * repeatedly, e.g. every time the quote changes or a line is added.
     */
    ensureQuoteLink: function(quoteSysId) {
        if (!quoteSysId) {
            return null;
        }

        var quoteGR = new GlideRecord(this.TABLES.QUOTE);
        if (!quoteGR.get(quoteSysId)) {
            return null;
        }

        var opportunitySysId = quoteGR.getValue('source_opportunity');

        // Reuse whatever process record already tracks this quote, whether it
        // was created via its opportunity or created directly for the quote.
        var salesProcessRecordId = this._findSalesProcessRecordForLinkedObject(quoteSysId, this.TYPES.QUOTE);

        var quoteParentTable, quoteParentObject;

        if (opportunitySysId) {
            if (!salesProcessRecordId) {
                salesProcessRecordId = this._findSalesProcessRecordForLinkedObject(opportunitySysId, this.TYPES.OPPORTUNITY);
            }
            if (!salesProcessRecordId) {
                salesProcessRecordId = this.ensureOpportunityLink(opportunitySysId);
            } else {
                this._ensureLink(salesProcessRecordId, this.TYPES.OPPORTUNITY, opportunitySysId, this.TABLES.SPR, salesProcessRecordId);
            }
            if (!salesProcessRecordId) {
                return null;
            }

            quoteParentTable = this.TABLES.OPPORTUNITY;
            quoteParentObject = opportunitySysId;
        } else {
            if (!salesProcessRecordId) {
                salesProcessRecordId = this._createProcessRecordForQuote(quoteGR);
            }
            if (!salesProcessRecordId) {
                return null;
            }

            quoteParentTable = this.TABLES.SPR;
            quoteParentObject = salesProcessRecordId;
        }

        this._ensureLink(salesProcessRecordId, this.TYPES.QUOTE, quoteSysId, quoteParentTable, quoteParentObject);

        this._syncQuoteLines(salesProcessRecordId, quoteSysId);

        return salesProcessRecordId;
    },

    _syncQuoteLines: function(salesProcessRecordId, quoteSysId) {
        var lineGR = new GlideRecord(this.TABLES.QUOTE_LINE);
        lineGR.addQuery('quote', quoteSysId);
        lineGR.query();
        while (lineGR.next()) {
            var lineSysId = lineGR.getUniqueValue();
            if (!this._linkExists(salesProcessRecordId, lineSysId, this.TABLES.QUOTE, quoteSysId)) {
                this._createLink(salesProcessRecordId, this.TYPES.QUOTE_LINE, lineSysId, this.TABLES.QUOTE, quoteSysId);
            }
        }
    },

    /**
     * Ensures the full chain Process Record -> Opportunity -> Quote -> Order exists
     * for this order (building the upstream Quote/Opportunity links too if they
     * don't exist yet), and syncs the order's current line items underneath it.
     */
    ensureOrderLink: function(orderSysId) {
        if (!orderSysId) {
            return null;
        }

        var orderGR = new GlideRecord(this.TABLES.ORDER);
        if (!orderGR.get(orderSysId)) {
            return null;
        }

        var quoteSysId = orderGR.getValue('quote');
        if (!quoteSysId) {
            return null;
        }

        var salesProcessRecordId = this.ensureQuoteLink(quoteSysId);
        if (!salesProcessRecordId) {
            return null;
        }

        if (!this._linkExists(salesProcessRecordId, orderSysId, this.TABLES.QUOTE, quoteSysId)) {
            this._createLink(salesProcessRecordId, this.TYPES.ORDER, orderSysId, this.TABLES.QUOTE, quoteSysId);
        }

        this._syncOrderLines(salesProcessRecordId, orderSysId);

        return salesProcessRecordId;
    },

    _syncOrderLines: function(salesProcessRecordId, orderSysId) {
        var lineGR = new GlideRecord(this.TABLES.ORDER_LINE);
        lineGR.addQuery('order', orderSysId);
        lineGR.query();
        while (lineGR.next()) {
            var lineSysId = lineGR.getUniqueValue();
            if (!this._linkExists(salesProcessRecordId, lineSysId, this.TABLES.ORDER, orderSysId)) {
                this._createLink(salesProcessRecordId, this.TYPES.ORDER_LINE, lineSysId, this.TABLES.ORDER, orderSysId);
            }
        }
    },

    /**
     * Ensures the chain Process Record -> ... -> Order -> Order Case exists for this
     * order case, building the upstream Opportunity/Quote/Order links too if they
     * don't exist yet, and syncs the order case's current lines underneath it.
     */
    ensureOrderCaseLink: function(orderCaseSysId) {
        if (!orderCaseSysId) {
            return null;
        }

        var caseGR = new GlideRecord(this.TABLES.ORDER_CASE);
        if (!caseGR.get(orderCaseSysId)) {
            return null;
        }

        var orderSysId = caseGR.getValue('order_id');
        if (!orderSysId) {
            return null;
        }

        var salesProcessRecordId = this.ensureOrderLink(orderSysId);
        if (!salesProcessRecordId) {
            return null;
        }

        if (!this._linkExists(salesProcessRecordId, orderCaseSysId, this.TABLES.ORDER, orderSysId)) {
            this._createLink(salesProcessRecordId, this.TYPES.ORDER_CASE, orderCaseSysId, this.TABLES.ORDER, orderSysId);
        }

        this._syncOrderCaseLines(salesProcessRecordId, orderCaseSysId);

        return salesProcessRecordId;
    },

    _syncOrderCaseLines: function(salesProcessRecordId, orderCaseSysId) {
        var lineGR = new GlideRecord(this.TABLES.ORDER_CASE_LINE);
        lineGR.addQuery('parent', orderCaseSysId);
        lineGR.query();
        while (lineGR.next()) {
            var lineSysId = lineGR.getUniqueValue();
            if (!this._linkExists(salesProcessRecordId, lineSysId, this.TABLES.ORDER_CASE, orderCaseSysId)) {
                this._createLink(salesProcessRecordId, this.TYPES.ORDER_CASE_LINE, lineSysId, this.TABLES.ORDER_CASE, orderCaseSysId);
            }
        }
    },

    /**
     * Deactivates the process-resource link for this object, and recursively
     * deactivates anything linked underneath it (e.g. deleting a Quote also
     * deactivates its Quote Lines and any Order/Order Lines hanging off it;
     * deleting a line item just deactivates that one link).
     */
    deactivateLinkCascade: function(objectSysId) {
        if (!objectSysId) {
            return;
        }

        var childIds = [];
        var childGr = new GlideRecord(this.TABLES.RESOURCE);
        childGr.addQuery('parent_object', objectSysId);
        childGr.addQuery('active', true);
        childGr.query();
        while (childGr.next()) {
            childIds.push(childGr.getValue('object'));
        }

        var gr = new GlideRecord(this.TABLES.RESOURCE);
        gr.addQuery('object', objectSysId);
        gr.addQuery('active', true);
        gr.query();
        while (gr.next()) {
            gr.setValue('active', false);
            gr.update();
        }

        for (var i = 0; i < childIds.length; i++) {
            this.deactivateLinkCascade(childIds[i]);
        }
    },

    type: 'BOProcessChainUtil'
};]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-02 01:21:18</sys_created_on><sys_id>064570062b8b8f104deaf02ac891bfbc</sys_id><sys_mod_count>9</sys_mod_count><sys_name>BOProcessChainUtil</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Global" source="global">global</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Global">global</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_064570062b8b8f104deaf02ac891bfbc</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-24 21:58:24</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>
